programme.title: V Is For Vino
programme.desc: Southern Rhone may be the most beautiful wine region in France! Stunning landscapes, quaint villages, ancient geography, and tons of Côtes du Rhône vineyards, all winding along the Rhône River in the South of France. The winemakers have tremendous respect for the land and work hard to preserve its legacy. Join Vince and his friend and local Frenchman, Sarkis, on a road trip through this wonderful wine region while learning about the fresh & fun red, rosé, and white wines of Southern Rhône!

programme.title: Grand Earth
programme.desc: Deserts. Forests. Caves. Mountains. How have human beings adapted to living in the world’s most extraordinary environments? The sheer magnificence of the natural world takes centre stage in this exploration of some of Earth’s most beautiful and most unforgiving environments and the people who have, against the odds, made these places their home.

programme.title: The Colours of China
programme.desc: Five colours are an integral part of contemporary China and the ancient philosophy of Wu Xing. Each episode takes us to regions where we meet our characters, learn how Wu Xing sits in their lives and explore the landscapes they live in.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Phil arrives at the Imperial Sheraton, home of the Celestial Court and his base while he uncovers the enormous culinary exercise that takes place every day here. We begin the Celestial Court where the decisions on what to cook are tough but we end up with classic crispy skinned Roast Duck, Di Sum and a Wok fried Chilli Tempe thats a world beater.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: This place rocks and it does in a very Argentinian way.The best meat cooked to perfection is what we see and learn how to achieve. At Pampas meat is what they are all about and Chef Phil discovers thats why the place is packed out every night.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: This is an episode dedicated to decadence. Sit back, relax and salivate. Chef Phil and Chef Gaeton take us through the intracacies of making a modern boulliabase from scratch. It is an art. As well we will learn what herbs and spices it takes to lift any gin to levels heavenly.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: We are nearly 60 stories up looking over super KL modern city with the twin towers in our face. This is Italian high end cuisine cooked by owner/chef Modesto Marini himself. We see him with Chef Phil in the working kitchen cooking some Marini signatures and later at the bar delving into some mysterious cocktails.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: This Venue is quite simply downright impressive and the big question to come was will the kitchen produce a match for where it will be presented. We see Chef Phil work his way through the decadent degustation then migrate to the kitchen to learn about the preparation.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Another extraordinarily extravagant venue in the centre of the KL Culinary universe. Marble 8 is like a club for the rich and famous in New York or Hollywood and from from what Chef eats, drinks and cooks it could as well be.This is a lavish treat from the walk through the steak aging vault to the flaming crepe suzette prepared at the table.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Yet another culinary gem in the suburbs of KL.This is real Italian with an intense Abruzzian Italian at the helm. Chef Stefano is young and like most great Italian chefs Stefano’s inspiration came from his mothers cooking.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the best in KL for a decade and surprisingly with hardly an Italian to be seen, except for some of the customers. A pasta Carbonara without cream, Tapas done Malaysian style, extraordinary Italian and Spanish cuisines cooked by truly Malaysian chefs. Nothing unusual here.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Phil and Bar Mixologist Jonas get to work in one of Malaysia’s most fabulous bars. Perched open air on the 31st floor of a KL business centre skyscraper its the favourite evening relaxing spot for the rich and famous. Chef Philip and Mixologist the swedish, Jonas work through the recipes of the Elysium signature cocktails.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Phil isn't a natural morning person...not many chefs are...so a perfect and hearty breakfast for him is a lavish degustation at the St.Regis in Langkawi. We are talking free flow french champagne, pass around foi gras, caviar on blinis and smoked salmon just for starters then there's an imported lobster omelette as main course.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Lai Po Heen is inspired by the great ancestral homes of 19th Century Chinese tycoons which is appropriate given the restaurants current clientele. The Gulai House cuisine at the Datai in Langkawi is inspired by the requirements of the islands past royalty.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Darren Chin is the future of Malaysia cuisine and only after 2 years in his now beloved DC restaurant he was awarded the best restaurant and chef in Malaysia. His food is French and Japanese centric. His kitchen mood is European and intense. Focus is and perfection are everything. This is a kitchen operating at the highest professional level.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Malaysia took Chef Phil by surprise and this is the bonus episode that crams in highlights we just couldn't leave out. Like the Twin Towers M-Caffe mall located champagne caviar bar, The outrageous sunday buffet at the Mandarin Oriental, one of the best in the world and more...

programme.title: Top Travel
programme.desc: We head to 10 of Jamaica’s top spots in this one hour show—restaurants, hotels and natural wonders—to get a feel for this lush, historic and beautiful Caribbean Island from those in the know.

programme.title: V Is For Vino
programme.desc: Languedoc-Roussillon is France's largest wine region and has more organic vineyard land than anywhere else on the planet! Its sheer size means it can produce an enormous variety of wine styles, from sparkling wines to rich whites, spicy reds, and even luscious dessert wines. Biodynamic winemaking pioneer Gérard Bertrand takes center stage, highlighting why caring for the planet and producing incredible wines aren't mutually exclusive.
